```{r}
#Q1: What US county has recorded the highest average corn yield since 1990?
crops[SHORT_DESC == "CORN, GRAIN - YIELD, MEASURED IN BU / ACRE" & AGG_LEVEL_DESC == "COUNTY" & YEAR >= 1990, .(avg_yield = mean(as.numeric(VALUE), na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(STATE_NAME, COUNTY_NAME)][order(-avg_yield)]
# The county with the highest average corn yield since 1990 is Benton County, Washington with an average corn yield of 225.84 Bushels per acre. 
```


```{r}
#Q2: What is the highest reported annual corn yield? In what county?
crops[SHORT_DESC == "CORN, GRAIN - YIELD, MEASURED IN BU / ACRE" & AGG_LEVEL_DESC == "COUNTY", .(max_yield = max(as.numeric(VALUE), na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(STATE_NAME, COUNTY_NAME, YEAR)][order(-max_yield)]
# The highest reported annual corn yield was in 2016 in Sutter County, California with a yield of 264.1 bushels per acre. 
```
